title: Orbit and Terminal Anew
author: Vesper Sterling
blurb: Ivo Eastwick, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
